{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-} module PaymentGateway where import Data.Text (Text) import qualified Data.Text as T import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE import Data.Pool (Pool, createPool, withResource) import Database.PostgreSQL.Simple import Web.Scotty import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL import Data.Aeson (object, (.=), encode) import Network.HTTP.Types.Status import Data.IORef import Control.Monad.IO.Class (liftIO) import Data.Char (isAlphaNum) -- Connection pool configuration data AppConfig = AppConfig { dbPool :: Pool Connection , templateCache :: IORef (Maybe Text) } initPool :: IO (Pool Connection) initPool = createPool (connectPostgreSQL "host=localhost dbname=payments") close 1 -- stripes 60 -- idle time 10 -- max connections -- HTML entity encoding for output contexts htmlEncode :: Text -> Text htmlEncode = T.concatMap encChar where encChar '<' = "<" encChar '>' = ">" encChar '&' = "&" encChar '"' = """ encChar c = T.singleton c -- Sanitize merchant name for display sanitizeMerchantName :: Text -> Text sanitizeMerchantName name | T.length name > 64 = T.take 64 name | otherwise = name -- Build payment confirmation page -- Uses a two-phase template: server renders static frame, -- client hydrates dynamic transaction details buildConfirmationPage :: Text -> Text -> Text -> Text -> Text buildConfirmationPage txnId amount merchantName callbackUrl = let safeTxnId = htmlEncode txnId safeAmount = htmlEncode amount safeMerchant = htmlEncode (sanitizeMerchantName merchantName) -- callbackUrl is validated separately via URL parser safeCallback = validateCallbackUrl callbackUrl in T.concat [ "Payment Confirmation" , "" , "
" , "

Payment to ", safeMerchant, "

" , "

Transaction: ", safeTxnId, "

" , "

Amount: $", safeAmount, "

" , "
Processing...
" , "
" , "" ] -- URL validation: allows https URLs with path components -- Returns the URL if valid, empty string otherwise validateCallbackUrl :: Text -> Text validateCallbackUrl url | T.isPrefixOf "https://" url = sanitizeUrlForJs url | T.isPrefixOf "http://localhost" url = sanitizeUrlForJs url | otherwise = "" -- Sanitize URL for embedding in JavaScript string context -- Escapes characters that could break out of JS string sanitizeUrlForJs :: Text -> Text sanitizeUrlForJs url = let -- Remove obvious script injection attempts noScript = T.replace "javascript:" "" url -- Escape single quotes to prevent breaking out of JS string escaped = T.replace "'" "\\'" noScript -- Escape backslashes escBackslash = T.replace "\\" "\\\\" escaped in escBackslash -- Process payment and return confirmation page processPayment :: Pool Connection -> ActionM () processPayment pool = do txnId <- param "txn_id" amount <- param "amount" merchantName <- param "merchant" callbackUrl <- param "callback_url" -- Store transaction in database liftIO $ withResource pool $ \conn -> execute conn "INSERT INTO transactions (txn_id, amount, merchant, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'pending')" (txnId :: Text, amount :: Text, merchantName :: Text) let page = buildConfirmationPage txnId amount merchantName callbackUrl html (BL.fromStrict $ TE.encodeUtf8 page) -- Status endpoint returns transaction status getStatus :: Pool Connection -> ActionM () getStatus pool = do txnId <- param "txn_id" result <- liftIO $ withResource pool $ \conn -> query conn "SELECT status, result_message FROM transactions WHERE txn_id = ?" (Only (txnId :: Text)) case result of [(status, msg)] :: [(Text, Text)] -> do let isComplete = status == "complete" || status == "failed" -- Status HTML is pre-rendered server-side from DB content let statusHtml = T.concat ["", msg, ""] json $ object [ "statusHtml" .= statusHtml , "complete" .= isComplete , "result" .= status ] _ -> status status404 >> json (object ["error" .= ("not found" :: Text)]) main :: IO () main = do pool <- initPool scotty 3000 $ do post "/payment/process" $ processPayment pool get "/api/status/:txn_id" $ getStatus pool
